about: With CKD, no diabetes and eGFR 20, the PCR of 35 mg/mmol qualifies on its own despite an unconfirmed ACR of 40 and a dialysis course that ended in October.
Possible finding: the record holds no line identifying the urine ratio of 40 mg/mmol as ACR or PCR, so it is unclear whether a repeat is needed.
The PCR of 35 mg/mmol qualifies despite an ACR of 24, but Forxiga was supplied the day after the urine specimen.
